evidence.line: Dwight: Look what just arrived from the Nashua branch. [reads from card attached to gift basket] 'Here's something to enjoy on your three non-vacation days. Nashua branch.' Can I send them a dead deer?
Michael: ...we are going to us it as a reward for the end of our competition.
Michael: Whichever branch loses the most weight gets three extra vacation days.
